steps.title: An editor that remembers the cursor
steps.titleZh: 记得光标位置的编辑区
steps.text: The bordered box is editable and holds `Hello world`. Clicking a button outside it moves focus away, and the cursor would be lost. So each time you click, type or change something in the editor, `cursor.js` saves a copy of the current Range: a start and an end, each given as a node plus an offset inside that node.
steps.textZh: 带边框的方框可以编辑，里面是 `Hello world`。点击它外面的按钮会让焦点离开，光标也就跟着丢了。所以每当你在编辑区里点击、打字或做了修改，`cursor.js` 都会把当前的 Range 复制一份存起来。Range 由一个起点和一个终点组成，每个点都用“某个节点 + 节点内的偏移量”来表示。

steps.title: Put the cursor after Hello
steps.titleZh: 把光标放在 Hello 后面
steps.text: This button puts the cursor 5 characters into the text, right after `Hello`, and sends a `keyup` event, as a key press would. `cursor.js` hears it and saves the Range.
steps.textZh: 这个按钮把光标放在文字的第 5 个字符之后，也就是 `Hello` 后面，再发出一个 `keyup` 事件，就像按了一下键。`cursor.js` 收到这个事件，把 Range 存了起来。

action.run: const editor = document.querySelector('#edit'); editor.focus(); const range = document.createRange(); range.setStart(editor.firstChild, 5); range.collapse(true); getSelection().removeAllRanges(); getSelection().addRange(range); editor.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup'))

steps.actionLabelZh: 把光标放到 Hello 后面

watch.label: text before the cursor
watch.value: (() => { const editor = document.querySelector('#edit'); const selection = getSelection(); if (!selection.rangeCount || !editor.contains(selection.anchorNode)) return '—'; const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(editor); range.setEnd(selection.anchorNode, selection.anchorOffset); return range.toString(); })()

steps.title: Insert at the saved cursor
steps.text: Clicking **Insert at saved cursor** takes focus away from the editor, but the saved Range still points after `Hello`. The click handler puts focus back, inserts a text node with the ✨ from the text field there, and moves the cursor right after it, so you can keep typing.
steps.textZh: 点击 **Insert at saved cursor** 会让焦点离开编辑区，但保存的 Range 仍然指向 `Hello` 后面。点击处理函数先把焦点放回编辑区，在那里插入一个文本节点，内容是文本框里的 ✨，再把光标移到它后面，这样就可以接着打字。
steps.actionLabelZh: 点击 Insert at saved cursor

watch.label: text before the cursor
watch.value: (() => { const editor = document.querySelector('#edit'); const selection = getSelection(); if (!selection.rangeCount || !editor.contains(selection.anchorNode)) return '—'; const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(editor); range.setEnd(selection.anchorNode, selection.anchorOffset); return range.toString(); })()

steps.title: Replace a selection
steps.text: When text is selected, the saved Range covers it, and `range.deleteContents()` removes it before the insert. This button selects `world`, puts 🌍 in the text field and clicks **Insert at saved cursor**.
steps.textZh: 选中了文字时，保存的 Range 覆盖的就是这段文字，插入之前 `range.deleteContents()` 会先把它删掉。这个按钮选中 `world`，把文本框改成 🌍，再点击 **Insert at saved cursor**。

action.run: const editor = document.querySelector('#edit'); const walker = document.createTreeWalker(editor, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); let node = walker.nextNode(); while (node && !node.data.includes('world')) node = walker.nextNode(); if (!node) return console.log('There is no world left to select. Reload the page to start again.'); const start = node.data.indexOf('world'); editor.focus(); const range = document.createRange(); range.setStart(node, start); range.setEnd(node, start + 5); getSelection().removeAllRanges(); getSelection().addRange(range); editor.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup')); document.querySelector('#sendEmoji').click()

watch.label: text before the cursor
watch.value: (() => { const editor = document.querySelector('#edit'); const selection = getSelection(); if (!selection.rangeCount || !editor.contains(selection.anchorNode)) return '—'; const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(editor); range.setEnd(selection.anchorNode, selection.anchorOffset); return range.toString(); })()

steps.title: Try it with the mouse
steps.text: Click somewhere inside the text, then click into the text field and type something else. The editor has lost focus, but the saved Range has not: **Insert at saved cursor** puts your text where the cursor was. On a freshly loaded page, before you touch the editor, nothing is saved yet, so the text goes at the end.
steps.textZh: 在文字中间随便点一下，然后点进文本框，输入别的内容。编辑区已经失去了焦点，但保存的 Range 还在：点击 **Insert at saved cursor**，你的文字就会出现在刚才光标所在的位置。在刚加载的页面上，如果还没碰过编辑区，就什么都没保存，文字会加在末尾。
